company.name: Print-Life
company.shortDescription: Print-Life is a platform that offers artificial intelligence solutions and 3D cloud printing services.
company.description: Print-Life provides artificial intelligence solutions and 3D cloud printing services. The usage of CT scans and magnetic resonance imaging is made possible through their collaboration with doctors, hospitals, and healthcare systems. The equipment, programs, operating systems and operational requirements necessary for the success of the work is provided, along with the necessary expertise to operate and maintain this equipment, to support the establishment, management, operation, and maintenance of this section for physicians, hospitals, and health care systems to provide this service to their patients.

productsAndServices.description: Provides 3D printing solutions for creating patient-specific models from CT and MRI scans for use in medical diagnostics and surgical planning.
productsAndServices.name: 3D Cloud Printing Services

productsAndServices.description: Utilizes AI to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of medical imaging analysis, aiding in the transformation of images into 3D models for surgical use.
productsAndServices.name: Artificial Intelligence Solutions

productsAndServices.description: Offers custom 3D printed models for various medical specialties including orthopedics, cardiovascular, and oncology to assist in preoperative planning and reduce surgical risks.
productsAndServices.name: Patient-specific Reference Models

productsAndServices.description: Provides comprehensive support for the setup, management, and maintenance of 3D printing technology in medical facilities, including necessary hardware, software, and training.
productsAndServices.name: Support and Maintenance Services
